question_en: A periodic function f(t) is defined in the interval (−π, π) as f(t)=0 for −π<t<0 and f(t)=2V₀ for 0<t<π. Fourier coefficients (aₙ and bₙ for sine and cosine parts) of the Fourier series of the signal are:
question_gu: A periodic function f(t) is defined in the interval (−π, π) as f(t)=0 for −π<t<0 and f(t)=2V₀ for 0<t<π. Fourier coefficients (aₙ and bₙ) are:
options_en: aₙ=0, bₙ=0 for even n; bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for odd n
aₙ=0, bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for even n; bₙ=0 for odd n
a₀=2V₀, aₙ=0 (n>0), bₙ=0 for even n; bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for odd n
a₀=2V₀, aₙ=0 (n>0), bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for even n; bₙ=0 for odd n
options_gu: aₙ=0, bₙ=0 for even n; bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for odd n
aₙ=0, bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for even n; bₙ=0 for odd n
a₀=2V₀, aₙ=0 (n>0), bₙ=0 for even n; bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for odd n
a₀=2V₀, aₙ=0 (n>0), bₙ=4V₀/(nπ) for even n; bₙ=0 for odd n
explanation_en: For the piecewise function, a₀=(1/π)∫₀^π2V₀dt=2V₀ and aₙ=(1/π)∫₀^π2V₀cos(nt)dt=0. Also bₙ=(1/π)∫₀^π2V₀sin(nt)dt=2V₀(1−cos nπ)/(nπ), which is 4V₀/(nπ) for odd n and zero for even n. Hence C.
explanation_gu: a₀=(1/π)∫₀^π2V₀dt=2V₀ અને aₙ=0 મળે છે. bₙ=2V₀(1−cos nπ)/(nπ), તેથી odd n માટે 4V₀/(nπ) અને even n માટે zero. એટલે C સાચો જવાબ છે.
tip_en: For a half-wave step function, check a₀, then use 1−(−1)ⁿ to identify odd harmonics.
tip_gu: Step-type Fourier functionમાં પહેલા a₀ કાઢો અને 1−(−1)ⁿથી odd/even harmonics ઓળખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A coin toss experiment is conducted using a biased coin with only 30% chance of returning head. The probability of getting exactly 2 heads in 5 trials is:
question_gu: 30% head probability ધરાવતા biased coinને 5 વખત toss કરતાં exactly 2 heads મળવાની probability કેટલી?
explanation_en: Use the binomial distribution: P(X=2)=C(5,2)(0.3)²(0.7)³=10×0.09×0.343=0.3087≈31%. Hence C.
explanation_gu: Binomial formula: P(X=2)=C(5,2)(0.3)²(0.7)³=0.3087≈31%. એટલે C.
tip_en: Exactly r successes in n trials: C(n,r)pʳ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ʳ.
tip_gu: Exactly r successes માટે C(n,r)pʳ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ʳ યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Consider f(z)=2z³−3iz²+4, where z is a complex variable. Which statement is TRUE?
question_gu: f(z)=2z³−3iz²+4 માટે કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: f(z) is holomorphic everywhere in the complex plane
f(z) is holomorphic in some regions of the complex plane
f(z) is holomorphic only near z=0 but not elsewhere
options_gu: f(z) is holomorphic everywhere in the complex plane
f(z) is holomorphic in some regions of the complex plane
f(z) is holomorphic only near z=0 but not elsewhere
explanation_en: f(z) is a polynomial in z with constant complex coefficients. Every polynomial is entire, so it is holomorphic at every finite point of the complex plane.
explanation_gu: f(z) z નો polynomial છે અને polynomial દરેક finite complex z માટે analytic/holomorphic હોય છે. તેથી A.
tip_en: Polynomial in z only → entire function.
tip_gu: માત્ર z નું polynomial હોય તો function entire હોય છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Matrix A=[[2,1],[3,4]], then 4A²−6A+5I (I is the identity matrix) is:
explanation_en: For A, trace=6 and determinant=5. By Cayley–Hamilton, A²−6A+5I=0, so A²=6A−5I. Therefore 4A²−6A+5I=3A².
explanation_gu: Trace(A)=6 અને det(A)=5. Cayley–Hamilton theoremથી A²−6A+5I=0, એટલે A²=6A−5I. તેથી 4A²−6A+5I=3A². જવાબ B.
tip_en: For a 2×2 matrix, use A²−(Tr A)A+(det A)I=0.
tip_gu: 2×2 matrix માટે Cayley–Hamiltonનું A²−Tr(A)A+det(A)I=0 સીધું વાપરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The value of the integral G(F)=∫₋∞^∞δ(x)e^(i2πFx)dx, where δ(x) is the Dirac delta, is:
question_gu: Dirac delta function માટે G(F)=∫₋∞^∞δ(x)e^(i2πFx)dx નું મૂલ્ય શું છે?
explanation_en: Using the sifting property ∫δ(x)g(x)dx=g(0), we obtain G(F)=e^(i2πF·0)=1.
explanation_gu: Dirac deltaની sifting propertyથી ∫δ(x)g(x)dx=g(0). તેથી G(F)=e^0=1. જવાબ B.
tip_en: Whenever δ(x) multiplies a smooth function, evaluate that function at x=0.
tip_gu: δ(x) હોય ત્યારે સાથેનું function x=0 પર મૂકો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A complex number satisfies z²+2z+1=0. Then the value of z for which the real and imaginary parts are non-zero is:
question_gu: z²+2z+1=0 હોય ત્યારે real અને imaginary બંને parts non-zero હોય તેવું z કયું છે?
explanation_en: The official GSET final key marks B. However, z²+2z+1=(z+1)², whose only root is z=−1, so none of the listed options satisfies the equation while having both parts non-zero.
explanation_gu: Official final keyમાં B આપેલું છે. પરંતુ z²+2z+1=(z+1)² હોવાથી સાચો mathematical root z=−1 છે; તેથી આપેલા optionsમાંથી કોઈ પણ equation satisfy કરતું નથી. Official key જ appમાં રાખી છે.
review_note: Official final key = B, but the displayed equation/options are mathematically inconsistent. Retain official key for historical-paper fidelity; flag for review.
tip_en: Always substitute a proposed complex root back into the original equation when the options look inconsistent.
tip_gu: Complex-number MCQમાં optionને original equationમાં substitute કરીને જરૂર ચકાસો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The second term in the Taylor series expansion of (n²−1)/(n²+2n+1) around 0 is:
question_gu: (n²−1)/(n²+2n+1) નું 0 આસપાસ Taylor expansionમાં second term શું છે?
explanation_en: Write the function as (n²−1)/(1+n)². Using (1+n)^−2=1−2n+3n²−..., multiplication gives −1+2n−2n²+..., so the second term is 2n.
explanation_gu: (n²−1)/(1+n)² લખો. (1+n)^−2=1−2n+3n²−... વાપરતાં expansion −1+2n−2n²+... મળે છે. તેથી second term 2n, એટલે C.
tip_en: Remember (1+x)^−2=1−2x+3x²−4x³+....
tip_gu: (1+x)^−2 નું standard expansion યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Bisection method is used to estimate the roots of n²−4=0 with initial values a=0 and b=6. The value of the estimated root after 5 iterations is:
question_gu: n²−4=0 માટે bisection methodમાં a=0 અને b=6 હોય તો 5 iterations પછી estimated root શું હશે?
explanation_en: For f(n)=n²−4: midpoints are 3, 1.5, 2.25, 1.875, and 2.0625. Thus after the fifth iteration the estimate is 2.062, corresponding to C.
explanation_gu: Midpoints ક્રમે 3, 1.5, 2.25, 1.875 અને 2.0625 આવે છે. એટલે 5th iterationનું estimate ≈2.062, એટલે C.
tip_en: In bisection, calculate midpoint and retain the half-interval where the sign changes.
tip_gu: દરેક iterationમાં midpoint લો અને sign-change ધરાવતો half interval રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The residue of f(z)=4z²/[(z¹¹+2)(z−1)] for a simple pole at z=1 is:
question_gu: z=1 પર simple pole માટે f(z)=4z²/[(z¹¹+2)(z−1)] નો residue શું છે?
explanation_en: The official final key marks B. Direct residue calculation gives lim(z→1)(z−1)f(z)=4/(1+2)=4/3, which corresponds to option D. Therefore this item is flagged as a key/question inconsistency.
explanation_gu: Official final key B આપે છે. પરંતુ residue = lim(z→1)(z−1)f(z)=4/(1+2)=4/3 આવે છે, જે option D છે. તેથી આ પ્રશ્નને Review Flag સાથે રાખ્યો છે.
review_note: Official final key = B, while direct residue calculation gives D (4/3). Preserve official key and flag discrepancy.
tip_en: For a simple pole at z=z₀, residue is lim(z→z₀)(z−z₀)f(z).
tip_gu: Simple pole માટે residue = lim(z→z₀)(z−z₀)f(z).
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Value of third order (n=3) Laguerre polynomial L₃(n) at n=1 is:
question_gu: Third-order Laguerre polynomial L₃(n) નું n=1 પર value શું છે?
tip_en: Keep the standard low-order Laguerre polynomials handy for NET/GSET numerical questions.
tip_gu: NET/GSET માટે low-order Laguerre polynomialsના forms યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Which of the following is true for a covariant tensor?
question_gu: Covariant tensor માટે કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: It transforms using inverse of the Jacobian matrix
It transforms using the Jacobian matrix
It does not transform under coordinate changes
It transforms as a covariant vector
options_gu: It transforms using inverse of the Jacobian matrix
It transforms using the Jacobian matrix
It does not transform under coordinate changes
It transforms as a covariant vector
explanation_en: The official final key marks B. In standard tensor notation, a covariant tensor transforms with the Jacobian corresponding to the transformation of covariant components; terminology depends on which old/new coordinate convention is used. This item is therefore retained with a review note rather than silently changing the official key.
explanation_gu: Official final key B છે. Covariant components માટે Jacobian/inverse-Jacobianનું રૂપાંતરણ old/new coordinate convention પર notation મુજબ લખાય છે. તેથી historical fidelity માટે B જ રાખ્યો છે અને Review Note આપ્યું છે.
review_note: Transformation wording depends on coordinate convention; official key B is preserved. Review before using as a theory-only question.
tip_en: Always write the coordinate transformation explicitly before deciding Jacobian versus inverse Jacobian.
tip_gu: Jacobian કે inverse Jacobian નક્કી કરતાં પહેલાં old/new coordinate transformation સ્પષ્ટ લખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In electrical circuits, the Laplace transform is used to analyze circuit behavior. If V(s) is the Laplace transform of the time-varying voltage, what does the variable s represent?
question_gu: Electrical circuitsમાં Laplace transform માટે V(s) હોય તો variable s શું દર્શાવે છે?
options_en: Complex frequency, including decay and oscillation
options_gu: Complex frequency, including decay and oscillation
explanation_en: The Laplace variable is s=σ+iω. The real part σ represents exponential growth/decay and the imaginary part ω represents oscillation frequency. Hence B.
explanation_gu: Laplace variable s=σ+iω છે. σ decay/growth દર્શાવે છે અને ω oscillation frequency દર્શાવે છે. એટલે B.
tip_en: Remember s=σ+iω.
tip_gu: સૌથી મહત્વનું relation: s=σ+iω.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Coriolis effect is most noticeable:
question_gu: Coriolis effect સૌથી વધુ ક્યાં noticeable છે?
explanation_en: The Coriolis parameter is proportional to 2Ωsinφ. Its magnitude is maximum at the poles (φ=±90°) and zero at the equator (φ=0°). Hence A.
explanation_gu: Coriolis term 2Ωsinφ પર આધારિત છે. Pole પર sinφ=1 અને equator પર sinφ=0, તેથી effect poles પર maximum છે. A.
tip_en: Coriolis effect ∝ sin(latitude): maximum at poles, zero at equator.
tip_gu: Coriolis effect ∝ sin(latitude): poles પર maximum, equator પર zero.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A particle of mass m moves under the potential V(r)=A/r²−B/r, where A,B>0. The frequency ω of small oscillations around the equilibrium point is:
question_gu: V(r)=A/r²−B/r potentialમાં equilibrium point આસપાસ small oscillationsની frequency ω શું છે?
explanation_en: Equilibrium satisfies V'(r₀)=−2A/r₀³+B/r₀²=0, giving r₀=2A/B. For small oscillations, ω²=V''(r₀)/m. Since V''=6A/r⁴−2B/r³, substitution gives V''(r₀)=B⁴/(8A³). Therefore ω=√(B⁴/(8mA³)), option C.
explanation_gu: V'(r₀)=0થી r₀=2A/B મળે છે. Small oscillation માટે ω²=V''(r₀)/m. V''=6A/r⁴−2B/r³ મૂકતાં V''(r₀)=B⁴/(8A³). તેથી ω=√(B⁴/(8mA³)), એટલે C.
tip_en: Small oscillation frequency: ω=√(V''(x₀)/m) at a stable equilibrium.
tip_gu: Stable equilibrium માટે ω=√(V''(x₀)/m) યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Lagrangian for a particle of mass m moving in a central force field is L=(m/2)(ṙ²+r²θ̇²)+k/r. Which represents a conserved quantity?
question_gu: Central force fieldમાં L=(m/2)(ṙ²+r²θ̇²)+k/r હોય તો conserved quantity કયું છે?
explanation_en: The coordinate θ does not appear explicitly in L, so θ is cyclic. Its conjugate momentum pθ=∂L/∂θ̇=mr²θ̇ is conserved. Hence A.
explanation_gu: Lagrangianમાં θ explicitly નથી, એટલે θ cyclic coordinate છે. તેથી pθ=∂L/∂θ̇=mr²θ̇ conserved છે. A.
tip_en: Cyclic coordinate → corresponding canonical momentum is conserved.
tip_gu: Cyclic coordinate હોય તો તેનું canonical momentum conserved રહે છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Two masses m₁ and m₂ are connected by three springs with spring constants K₁, K₂ and K₃, and the masses are free to move in one dimension. The number of generalized coordinates needed to describe the motion is:
question_gu: બે masses m₁ અને m₂ one-dimensional motionમાં હોય તો motion describe કરવા કેટલા generalized coordinates જોઈએ?
explanation_en: Each free mass has one independent displacement coordinate in one dimension. There are two masses, so two independent generalized coordinates are required.
explanation_gu: દરેક mass માટે one-dimensionalમાં એક independent displacement coordinate જોઈએ. બે masses હોવાથી કુલ 2 generalized coordinates જોઈએ. B.
tip_en: Number of generalized coordinates equals the number of independent degrees of freedom.
tip_gu: Generalized coordinatesની સંખ્યા = independent degrees of freedom.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: For a rigid body, the diagonal components of the moment of inertia tensor represent
question_gu: Rigid body માટે moment of inertia tensor ના diagonal components શું દર્શાવે છે?
explanation_en: In principal axes, the inertia tensor is diagonal and its diagonal elements are the principal moments of inertia I₁, I₂ and I₃. Hence B.
explanation_gu: Principal axesમાં inertia tensor diagonal બને છે અને તેના diagonal elements I₁, I₂, I₃ principal moments of inertia હોય છે. એટલે B.
tip_en: Diagonalize the inertia tensor to identify the principal moments.
tip_gu: Inertia tensorને diagonalize કરતાં principal moments મળે છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In a two body collision problem of two masses m₁ and m₂ moving with velocities v₁ and v₂ respectively, the velocity of the centre of mass is given by
question_gu: m₁ અને m₂ masses અનુક્રમે v₁ અને v₂ velocityથી ચાલે ત્યારે centre of massની velocity શું છે?
explanation_en: The centre-of-mass velocity is total momentum divided by total mass: V_CM=(m₁v₁+m₂v₂)/(m₁+m₂). Hence B.
explanation_gu: V_CM = કુલ momentum / કુલ mass = (m₁v₁+m₂v₂)/(m₁+m₂). એટલે B.
tip_en: For two particles, use mass-weighted average of their velocities.
tip_gu: Centre-of-mass velocity એટલે velocityનું mass-weighted average.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A rigid rod of negligible thickness has N rotational degrees of freedom in a 3-space coordinate system. Then N equals
question_gu: 3-dimensional spaceમાં negligible thickness ધરાવતા rigid rodના rotational degrees of freedom N કેટલા છે?
explanation_en: A rigid body in three-dimensional space has three independent rotational degrees of freedom, corresponding to its orientation. Thus N=3, option C.
explanation_gu: 3Dમાં rigid bodyની orientation નક્કી કરવા 3 independent rotational degrees of freedom જોઈએ. તેથી N=3, એટલે C.
tip_en: Rigid body in 3D: 3 translational + 3 rotational degrees of freedom.
tip_gu: 3D rigid body માટે કુલ 6 DOF: 3 translational + 3 rotational.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A two dimensional dynamical system is governed by the Lagrangian L = k²(ẋ² + ẏ²) − m²(x + y)². The Hamiltonian in this case becomes
question_gu: L = k²(ẋ² + ẏ²) − m²(x+y)² હોય તો corresponding Hamiltonian શું છે?
explanation_en: Using H = Σ pᵢq̇ᵢ − L and pₓ=2k²ẋ, pᵧ=2k²ẏ, we get H = k²(ẋ²+ẏ²)+m²(x+y)². This is option D.
explanation_gu: pₓ=∂L/∂ẋ=2k²ẋ અને pᵧ=2k²ẏ. તેથી H=pₓẋ+pᵧẏ−L = k²(ẋ²+ẏ²)+m²(x+y)². એટલે D.
tip_en: Use H=Σpᵢq̇ᵢ−L; if the question leaves H in velocity form, substitute p=∂L/∂q̇ back into H.
tip_gu: H=Σpᵢq̇ᵢ−L formula વાપરો અને p=∂L/∂q̇ substitute કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In the recent SOLAR mission by ISRO, Aditya L1 is believed to move in a “halo” orbit around an axis connecting the SUN and the EARTH. Select the correct statement from below on the “Halo Orbit”.
question_gu: ISROની Aditya L1 missionમાં Sun–Earth axisની આસપાસ halo orbit માટે કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: It is an elliptical orbit in 3-space
It is an elliptical orbit in 2-space
It is a circular orbit in 2-space
It is a circular orbit in 3-space
options_gu: It is an elliptical orbit in 3-space
It is an elliptical orbit in 2-space
It is a circular orbit in 2-space
It is a circular orbit in 3-space
explanation_en: A halo orbit is a three-dimensional periodic orbit around a collinear Lagrange point in the restricted three-body problem. The Aditya-L1 spacecraft follows a three-dimensional halo orbit about the Sun–Earth L1 region. Hence D.
explanation_gu: Halo orbit restricted three-body problemમાં Lagrange pointની આસપાસનું 3-dimensional periodic orbit છે. Aditya-L1 Sun–Earth L1 regionની આસપાસ halo orbitમાં ચાલે છે. એટલે D.
tip_en: Halo orbit is 3D; do not confuse it with a planar Lissajous or ordinary circular orbit.
tip_gu: Halo orbit 3D હોય છે; તેને ordinary circular orbit સાથે confuse ન કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Lagrangian L(qᵢ, q̇ᵢ, t) is defined for all cyclic coordinates. Select the correct statement from below.
question_gu: Lagrangian L(qᵢ,q̇ᵢ,t)માં cyclic coordinates માટે કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: The canonical conjugates pᵢ to qᵢ are conserved
The canonical conjugates pᵢ to qᵢ are not conserved
options_gu: The canonical conjugates pᵢ to qᵢ are conserved
The canonical conjugates pᵢ to qᵢ are not conserved
explanation_en: If qᵢ is cyclic, ∂L/∂qᵢ=0. Euler–Lagrange gives d pᵢ/dt=0, so its canonical conjugate momentum pᵢ is conserved. Hence A.
explanation_gu: Cyclic coordinate માટે ∂L/∂qᵢ=0. Euler–Lagrangeથી dpᵢ/dt=0 મળે છે, એટલે canonical momentum pᵢ conserved છે. A.
review_note: The wording 'for all cyclic coordinates' is broad; the conserved statement applies to each coordinate that is cyclic. Preserve the official key A.
tip_en: Cyclic coordinate → conserved canonical momentum.
tip_gu: Cyclic coordinate હોય તો corresponding canonical momentum conserved.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The time dependent Hamilton-Jacobi equation for a harmonic system described with two degrees of freedom is given by
question_gu: Two degrees of freedom ધરાવતા harmonic system માટે time-dependent Hamilton–Jacobi equation કઈ છે?
explanation_en: For two generalized coordinates, the Hamilton–Jacobi equation is H(q₁,q₂, ∂W/∂q₁, ∂W/∂q₂,t)+∂W/∂t=0. Thus D is the specific two-degree-of-freedom form.
explanation_gu: બે generalized coordinates માટે H(q₁,q₂,∂W/∂q₁,∂W/∂q₂,t)+∂W/∂t=0. એટલે D.
tip_en: HJ equation: replace pᵢ by ∂W/∂qᵢ and add ∂W/∂t.
tip_gu: HJ equation માટે pᵢ → ∂W/∂qᵢ અને +∂W/∂t=0.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The proper time (T) in special theory of relativity is given as dT² = (−c²dt² + dx² + dy² + dz²). Select the correct statement from the options below.
question_gu: Special relativityમાં dT² = (−c²dt² + dx² + dy² + dz²) હોય તો કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: dT² > 0 for space-like and dT² < 0 for time-like
dT² < 0 for space-like and dT² > 0 for time-like
dT² < 0 for space-like and dT² = 0 for time-like
dT² > 0 for space-like and dT² = 0 for time-like
options_gu: dT² > 0 for space-like and dT² < 0 for time-like
dT² < 0 for space-like and dT² > 0 for time-like
dT² < 0 for space-like and dT² = 0 for time-like
dT² > 0 for space-like and dT² = 0 for time-like
explanation_en: With the metric convention used in the question, the interval is negative for timelike separations and positive for spacelike separations; it is zero for lightlike separation. Hence A.
explanation_gu: આ metric conventionમાં timelike interval negative, spacelike interval positive અને lightlike માટે zero હોય છે. તેથી A.
tip_en: Always check the metric signature first; here the time term has the minus sign.
tip_gu: Metric signature પહેલા જુઓ; અહીં time term negative છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Electromagnetic wave of wavelength 532 nm, polarized parallel to the plane of incidence, is obliquely incident at an angle of 49° with respect to the surface normal at the interface between two non-magnetic dielectric media of refractive indices n₁=1.33 and n₂=1.53. The percentage of incident light which is reflected is
question_gu: 532 nm wavelengthનું p-polarized EM wave 49° incidence angle પર n₁=1.33 થી n₂=1.53 interface પર પડે છે. Reflected lightની percentage કેટલી?
explanation_en: For p-polarization, the Fresnel amplitude coefficient is rₚ=(n₂cosθᵢ−n₁cosθₜ)/(n₂cosθᵢ+n₁cosθₜ). Snell's law gives θₜ≈41.0°. At θᵢ=49°, which is essentially the Brewster angle arctan(n₂/n₁)≈49.0°, rₚ≈0, so the reflected percentage is approximately 0%. Hence A.
explanation_gu: p-polarization માટે Fresnel coefficient rₚ વાપરો. Snell lawથી θₜ≈41°. 49° angle લગભગ Brewster angle θ_B=tan⁻¹(n₂/n₁)≈49° છે, તેથી rₚ≈0 અને reflected intensity લગભગ 0%. એટલે A.
tip_en: At Brewster angle for non-magnetic dielectrics, p-polarized reflected intensity becomes zero.
tip_gu: Brewster angle પર p-polarized reflected intensity zero થાય છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: N charged drops each of charge q and radius r coalesce to form a big drop of radius R and charge Q. If V is the electric potential and E is the electric field at the surface of the drop, then
question_gu: q charge અને r radius ધરાવતા N charged drops ભેગા થઈ R radius અને Q chargeનો મોટો drop બનાવે છે. Surface પર potential V અને field E માટે કયું relation સાચું છે?
explanation_en: Charge conservation gives Q=Nq and volume conservation gives R=N^(1/3)r. Since V∝Q/R, V_big/V_small=N/(N^(1/3))=N^(2/3). Hence D.
explanation_gu: Q=Nq અને volume conservationથી R=N^(1/3)r. કારણ કે V∝Q/R, તેથી V_big/V_small=N^(2/3). એટલે D.
tip_en: For coalescing drops, use both charge conservation and volume conservation before comparing V or E.
tip_gu: Coalescing dropsમાં પહેલાં Q=Nq અને R=N^(1/3)r લખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A beam of linearly polarized light passes through two polarizers. The first is set at an angle of 45° to the initial polarization direction. The second is set at an angle of 90° to the initial polarization direction. The fraction of light intensity after second polarizer is
question_gu: Linearly polarized light બે polarizersમાંથી પસાર થાય છે. પ્રથમ 45° અને બીજો initial directionથી 90° પર છે. બીજા polarizer પછી intensityનો fraction કેટલો છે?
explanation_en: After the first polarizer, Malus' law gives I1=I0 cos²45°=I0/2. The angle between the two polarizers is 45°, so I2=I1 cos²45°=I0/4. Hence A.
explanation_gu: પ્રથમ polarizer પછી I1=I0 cos²45°=I0/2. બંને polarizers વચ્ચે 45° છે, તેથી I2=I1 cos²45°=I0/4. એટલે A.
tip_en: Always use the angle between successive polarizers in Malus' law.
tip_gu: Malus lawમાં successive polarizers વચ્ચેનો angle લો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Consider a uniformly magnetized circular cylinder of radius R with its axis coinciding with the z-axis. The magnetization inside the cylinder is M=M0 z-hat. H(r) and B(r) everywhere in space are
question_gu: z-axis સાથે coincident uniformly magnetized circular cylinder માટે, અંદર M=M0 z-hat હોય ત્યારે H(r) અને B(r) શું છે?
explanation_en: For the ideal infinitely long uniformly magnetized cylinder with M parallel to its axis, there are no magnetic poles on the cylindrical surface and no free current. The demagnetizing field is H=0, while B=μ0(H+M)=μ0M0 z-hat inside. Hence A.
explanation_gu: Ideal infinite uniformly magnetized cylinderમાં M axisની દિશામાં હોવાથી demagnetizing field H=0 થાય છે. B=μ0(H+M)=μ0M0 z-hat અંદર મળે છે. એટલે A.
review_note: The displayed options focus on regions r<R and the ideal-cylinder assumption. Preserve the official key A; for a finite cylinder, the field would be different.
tip_en: For an ideal infinite axial magnetization, think of zero demagnetizing field inside.
tip_gu: Infinite axial magnetization માટે અંદર demagnetizing field zero યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A pair of scalar (V) and vector (A) potentials are given by V(r,t)=0 and A(r,t)=−[1/(4π ε0)](qt/r²) r-hat. Where r-hat is the unit vector along r. Which of the following is TRUE?
question_gu: V(r,t)=0 અને A(r,t)=−[1/(4π ε0)](qt/r²) r-hat આપેલ હોય તો કયું statement સાચું છે?
options_en: The pair satisfy Coulomb and Lorenz gauge conditions
The pair satisfy Coulomb gauge condition only
The pair satisfy Lorenz gauge condition only
The pair satisfy neither Coulomb nor Lorenz gauge conditions
options_gu: The pair satisfy Coulomb and Lorenz gauge conditions
The pair satisfy Coulomb gauge condition only
The pair satisfy Lorenz gauge condition only
The pair satisfy neither Coulomb nor Lorenz gauge conditions
explanation_en: The vector potential is radial and proportional to t/r². Away from the origin, ∇·(r-hat/r²)=0, so ∇·A=0 and the Coulomb condition holds. Since V=0, the Lorenz condition ∇·A+(1/c²)∂V/∂t=0 also holds. Hence A.
explanation_gu: r-hat/r²નું divergence origin સિવાય zero છે, તેથી ∇·A=0 અને Coulomb gauge satisfy થાય છે. V=0 હોવાથી Lorenz condition પણ satisfy થાય છે. એટલે A.
review_note: Gauge conditions are understood away from the singular origin; the historical question does not explicitly discuss the singular point.
tip_en: Check Coulomb: ∇·A=0. Check Lorenz: ∇·A+(1/c²)∂V/∂t=0.
tip_gu: Coulomb માટે ∇·A અને Lorenz માટે ∇·A+(1/c²)∂V/∂t ચકાસો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Divergence of Maxwell stress tensor represents
question_gu: Maxwell stress tensorનું divergence શું દર્શાવે છે?
explanation_en: The divergence of the Maxwell stress tensor gives force density (force per unit volume), with the full momentum-balance equation including the electromagnetic momentum term. Thus B is the intended answer.
explanation_gu: Maxwell stress tensorનું divergence force density એટલે force per unit volume સાથે સંબંધિત છે. તેથી intended answer B છે.
tip_en: Stress itself is force/area; its divergence gives force density in the local momentum balance.
tip_gu: Stress = force/area, જ્યારે divergence of stress → force density.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Poynting’s theorem states that in a volume containing charges
question_gu: Charges ધરાવતા volume માટે Poynting theorem કયું relation આપે છે?
options_en: Work done on charges = decrease in field energy − energy flowing out through the surface
Work done on charges = decrease in field energy + energy flowing out through the surface
Work done on charges = decrease in field energy
Work done on charges = energy flowing out through the surface
options_gu: Work done on charges = decrease in field energy − energy flowing out through the surface
Work done on charges = decrease in field energy + energy flowing out through the surface
Work done on charges = decrease in field energy
Work done on charges = energy flowing out through the surface
explanation_en: From Poynting's theorem, work delivered to charges plus the outward electromagnetic energy flux equals the decrease in electromagnetic field energy. Therefore work on charges = decrease in field energy − outward energy flow. Hence A.
explanation_gu: Poynting theorem મુજબ decrease in field energy = charges પર work + outward energy flux. તેથી work = decrease in field energy − outward flux. એટલે A.
tip_en: Remember: field-energy decrease is shared between work on charges and outward Poynting flux.
tip_gu: Field energyનો decrease = charges પર work + બહાર જતો energy flux.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A point charge is moving with a speed of 0.1c. It changes its speed to 0.75c. What is the ratio of the electric fields of the charge at a point perpendicular to its direction of motion (after and before the increase in speed)?
question_gu: Point chargeની speed 0.1c થી 0.75c થાય છે. Motionની perpendicular directionમાં electric fieldનું after/before ratio કેટલું?
explanation_en: For a field point perpendicular to the instantaneous velocity, the relativistic field enhancement is E⊥=γE0. Thus the ratio is γ(0.75c)/γ(0.1c)=1/√(1−0.75²) divided by 1/√(1−0.1²), which is about 1.51≈1.5. Hence D.
explanation_gu: Perpendicular directionમાં E⊥=γE0. તેથી ratio γ(0.75c)/γ(0.1c)≈1.51≈1.5. એટલે D.
tip_en: For θ=90° in the relativistic point-charge field, E⊥ scales with γ.
tip_gu: Perpendicular field માટે relativistic factor γ યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Two linearly polarized plane wave fronts with an angle of 60° between their planes of polarization are superposed. If the intensities are I1=I0 and I2=0.7I0, the visibility (or contrast) of the resulting interference fringes is
question_gu: બે linearly polarized plane waves વચ્ચે polarization planesનો angle 60° છે. I1=I0 અને I2=0.7I0 હોય તો interference fringe visibility કેટલી?
explanation_en: For two beams with polarization angle θ, visibility V=[2√(I1I2)/(I1+I2)]|cosθ|. With θ=60°, I1=I0 and I2=0.7I0, V=√0.7/1.7≈0.493≈0.5. Hence C.
tip_en: Non-parallel polarization reduces interference visibility by the factor |cos θ|.
tip_gu: Polarization planes parallel ન હોય તો visibilityમાં |cosθ| factor આવે છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: On an average the intensity of sunlight received by Earth is 1380 W/m². The force exerted by sunlight on a perfect reflector of area 1 m² kept normal to it, on the surface of Earth, is
question_gu: Earth પર sunlight intensity 1380 W/m² હોય અને 1 m² perfect reflector normal હોય તો sunlight દ્વારા exerted force કેટલું?
explanation_en: For a perfect reflector at normal incidence, radiation pressure p=2I/c. Hence F=pA=2(1380)(1)/(3×10⁸)=9.2×10⁻⁶ N. Thus C.
explanation_gu: Perfect reflector માટે p=2I/c. તેથી F=2(1380)(1)/(3×10⁸)=9.2×10⁻⁶ N. એટલે C.
review_note: The original printed options use compact/scanned notation for the powers of ten; the numerical value corresponding to the official key C is 9.2×10⁻⁶ N.
tip_en: Absorber: p=I/c; perfect reflector: p=2I/c.
tip_gu: Absorber માટે I/c અને perfect reflector માટે 2I/c.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The power radiated by a single hydrogen atom, considering it an electric dipole (electron and proton separated by a distance equal to one Bohr radius) with electric dipole moment of 10×10⁻³⁰ C m, when subjected to a field oscillating at frequency 10¹⁵ Hz is
question_gu: Hydrogen atomને electric dipole માની, dipole moment 10×10⁻³⁰ C m અને oscillation frequency 10¹⁵ Hz હોય તો radiated power કેટલી?
explanation_en: For an oscillating electric dipole with peak moment p0, Pavg=p0²ω⁴/(12π ε0 c³), with ω=2πf. Substitution of the given dipole moment and f=10¹⁵ Hz gives a value of order 10⁻¹¹ W, matching option D.
explanation_gu: Oscillating electric dipole માટે Pavg=p0²ω⁴/(12π ε0c³), જ્યાં ω=2πf. આપેલી values મૂકતાં powerનો order 10⁻¹¹ W મળે છે, એટલે D.
review_note: The source scan prints the dipole-moment unit/form with compressed notation; preserve the official key D and the original numerical data rather than silently normalizing the historical wording.
tip_en: Use ω=2πf; forgetting the 2π factor causes a large error because power depends on ω⁴.
tip_gu: ω=2πf ભૂલશો નહીં; P∝ω⁴ હોવાથી મોટો difference પડે છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Electron number density n of a laser-induced lead-calcium plasma is 10²³ m⁻³. The cut-off frequency for this plasma is [ε0=8.85×10⁻¹² F/m, me=9.1×10⁻³¹ kg, e=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C]
question_gu: Laser-induced lead-calcium plasmaમાં electron number density 10²³ m⁻³ છે. આપેલા constants માટે cut-off frequency કેટલી?
explanation_en: The plasma angular frequency is ωp=√(ne²/(ε0me)); the cut-off frequency is fp=ωp/(2π). Substitution gives approximately 2.85×10¹² Hz. Hence D.
explanation_gu: ωp=√(ne²/(ε0me)) અને f_p=ωp/(2π). Values મૂકતાં f_p≈2.85×10¹² Hz મળે છે. એટલે D.
tip_en: Do not confuse plasma angular frequency ωp with ordinary frequency fp; divide by 2π.
tip_gu: ωp અને fp અલગ છે; fp=ωp/(2π).
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A subatomic particle produced in a nuclear collision has mc²=1228 MeV, with an uncertainty of ±56 MeV. If it travels with a speed of 10⁸ m/s after being produced, how far can it travel before it disintegrates?
question_gu: Nuclear collisionમાં બનેલા particle માટે mc²=1228 MeV અને uncertainty ±56 MeV છે. Speed 10⁸ m/s હોય તો disintegration પહેલાં કેટલું distance travel કરી શકે?
topic: Modern Physics — Uncertainty and Particle Lifetime
explanation_en: Using the energy-time uncertainty relation to estimate the lifetime from the mass-energy uncertainty, then multiplying the lifetime by the given speed gives a travel distance of approximately 5.86×10⁻¹⁶ m. Hence D.
explanation_gu: Energy-time uncertainty relationથી lifetime estimate કરીને d=vτ લેતાં distance લગભગ 5.86×10⁻¹⁶ m મળે છે. એટલે D.
review_note: The historical question uses an approximate lifetime estimate based on the stated mass-energy uncertainty; preserve the official key D.
tip_en: For unstable-particle estimates, use ΔE·Δt≈ħ/2 and then d≈vΔt.
tip_gu: Unstable particle માટે ΔEΔt≈ħ/2 અને પછી d≈vΔt વાપરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: An electron moves in a one-dimensional potential well of width 8 Å and depth 12 eV. Find the number of bound states present.
question_gu: 8 Å width અને 12 eV depth ધરાવતા one-dimensional finite potential wellમાં કેટલા bound states છે?
explanation_en: For a finite well, the allowed bound-state energies must lie below the well depth and satisfy the even/odd transcendental conditions. Using a=8 Å, V0=12 eV and the electron mass gives five bound levels. Hence C.
explanation_gu: Finite well માટે bound-state transcendental conditions અને આપેલા a=8 Å, V0=12 eV વાપરતાં કુલ 5 bound levels મળે છે. એટલે C.
tip_en: For finite wells, count the intersections of the even/odd transcendental equations rather than using the infinite-well formula alone.
tip_gu: Finite wellમાં infinite-well energy formulaથી સીધી count ન કરો; even/odd conditions વાપરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: A pair of virtual particles is created for a short time. During their existence a distance of 0.35 fm is covered with a speed very close to the speed of light. What is the value of mc² for each virtual particle?
question_gu: Virtual particles 0.35 fm distance લગભગ light speedથી cover કરે છે. તેમના માટે mc² કેટલું આવે છે?
explanation_en: The existence time is approximately Δt≈d/c. Using ΔEΔt≈ħ/2 gives ΔE≈ħc/(2d)≈281 MeV for the pair, so the energy associated with each particle is about 140.56 MeV. Hence C.
explanation_gu: Δt≈d/c અને ΔEΔt≈ħ/2થી pair માટે કુલ energy scale લગભગ 281 MeV આવે છે. બે particles માટે each mc²≈140.56 MeV. એટલે C.
tip_en: When the question asks for each particle in a pair, divide the pair energy scale by two if the particles share it equally.
tip_gu: Pairની total energyને બે સમાન particlesમાં વહેંચવી હોય તો 2થી divide કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: An electron in the n=2 state of hydrogen remains there on the average time of about 10⁻⁸ s before making a transition to n=1 state. Estimate the width of this line in the spectrum of hydrogen atom.
question_gu: Hydrogen atomના n=2 stateની lifetime લગભગ 10⁻⁸ s હોય તો spectral lineની width કેટલી હશે?
explanation_en: The finite lifetime gives an energy uncertainty ΔE≈ħ/(2τ). Converting this energy width to wavelength width around the n=2→1 hydrogen transition using Δλ≈(λ²/hc)ΔE gives the order 10⁻⁷ nm, matching option A.
explanation_gu: Finite lifetimeથી ΔE≈ħ/(2τ). પછી Δλ≈(λ²/hc)ΔE વડે wavelength width કાઢતાં લગભગ 10⁻⁷ nm મળે છે, એટલે A.
review_note: The numerical estimate depends on the convention used for lifetime/linewidth; preserve the official final key A for historical fidelity.
tip_en: Natural linewidth comes from lifetime broadening: shorter lifetime → larger ΔE and broader spectral line.
tip_gu: Lifetime ઓછી હોય તો ΔE વધારે અને spectral line broader થાય છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The expectation value of x component of spin angular momentum of a fermion in state [2, 1-i]^T is
question_gu: [2, 1-i]^T state માં fermionના spin angular momentumના x-componentનું expectation value શું છે?
explanation_en: For a spin-1/2 particle, Sx=(ℏ/2)σx. Normalizing the state (2,1-i), the norm squared is 4. Since ⟨σx⟩=2Re(a* b)/(|a|²+|b|²)=1, ⟨Sx⟩=ℏ/2.
explanation_gu: Spin-1/2 માટે Sx=(ℏ/2)σx. State (2,1-i)નું norm squared 4 છે અને ⟨σx⟩=1 મળે છે. તેથી ⟨Sx⟩=ℏ/2.
tip_en: For a two-component spinor, use the Pauli matrix σx directly.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Hamiltonian of a two-electron system is perturbed by an interaction α S1·S2, where α is a constant and S1 and S2 are spin angular momenta of electrons. Calculate the splitting between the S=0 and S=1 states by first-order perturbation.
question_gu: બે-electron systemમાં perturbation α S1·S2 છે. First-order perturbationથી S=0 અને S=1 states વચ્ચેનું splitting શોધો.
explanation_en: Using S1·S2=1/2[S²−S1²−S2²], for two spin-1/2 electrons the singlet (S=0) shift is −3αℏ²/4 and the triplet (S=1) shift is +αℏ²/4. Their difference is αℏ².
explanation_gu: S1·S2=1/2[S²−S1²−S2²] વાપરો. S=0 માટે shift −3αℏ²/4 અને S=1 માટે +αℏ²/4 છે. તેથી splitting αℏ².
tip_en: Two spin-1/2 particles: singlet −3/4ℏ², triplet +1/4ℏ².
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Estimate the kinetic energy of the particle trapped in a delta-function potential H=−(ℏ²/2m)d²/dx²−αδ(x), using the Gaussian trial wave function ψ(x)=A exp(−bx²).
question_gu: Delta-function potentialમાં Gaussian trial wave function ψ=A exp(−bx²) માટે kinetic energyનો estimate શોધો.
explanation_en: For ψ=Ae^(−bx²), d²ψ/dx²=(4b²x²−2b)ψ. For the normalized Gaussian, ⟨x²⟩=1/(4b). Thus ⟨T⟩=−(ℏ²/2m)⟨d²/dx²⟩=ℏ²b/(2m).
explanation_gu: ψ=Ae^(−bx²) માટે d²ψ/dx²=(4b²x²−2b)ψ અને normalized Gaussianમાં ⟨x²⟩=1/(4b). તેથી ⟨T⟩=ℏ²b/(2m).
tip_en: Gaussian trial function માટે derivative અને ⟨x²⟩=1/(4b) યાદ રાખો.

question_en: A particle of mass m is confined in the potential V(x)=1/2 mω²x² for x>0 and V(x)=α for x≤0. If ψ(x)=−1/√5 ψ0 + 2/√5 ψ1, where ψ0 and ψ1 are eigenfunctions of the ground and first excited states respectively, the expectation value of the energy is
question_gu: V(x)=½mω²x² (x>0) અને V(x)=α (x≤0) માટે ψ=−ψ0/√5+2ψ1/√5 હોય તો energyનું expectation value શું છે?
explanation_en: The official final key gives A. The scanned potential/eigenstate statement requires the boundary-condition-specific eigenenergies of the stated half-line potential; therefore the official key is preserved rather than replacing it with the simple full harmonic-oscillator estimate. Review is flagged because the displayed information alone does not uniquely reproduce option A without the specific eigenenergy convention.
explanation_gu: Official final key પ્રમાણે A રાખવામાં આવ્યો છે. આપેલ half-line potential માટે boundary-condition-specific eigenenergies જરૂરી છે; માત્ર full harmonic oscillatorના E0 અને E1થી C મળે છે. તેથી official key બદલ્યા વગર A રાખ્યો છે અને review flag આપ્યો છે.
review_note: Official key A is retained. A naive full harmonic-oscillator calculation using E0=ℏω/2 and E1=3ℏω/2 gives 13ℏω/10 (option C), so this item requires review of the intended half-line eigenenergy convention.
tip_en: When a piecewise potential is given, do not automatically use full harmonic-oscillator energies; check boundary conditions.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The recoil momentum of an atom is PA when it emits an infrared photon of wavelength 1500 nm, and it is PB when it emits a photon of visible wavelength 500 nm. The ratio PA/PB is
question_gu: Atom 1500 nm infrared photon emit કરે ત્યારે recoil momentum PA અને 500 nm visible photon emit કરે ત્યારે PB હોય, તો PA/PB શું છે?
explanation_en: Photon momentum is p=h/λ, and atomic recoil momentum has the same magnitude. Hence PA/PB=(1/1500)/(1/500)=1/3, so PA:PB=1:3.
explanation_gu: Photon momentum p=h/λ છે. તેથી PA/PB=(1/1500)/(1/500)=1/3 અને PA:PB=1:3.
tip_en: Recoil momentum is inversely proportional to photon wavelength.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: If x and p are the x components of the position and momentum operators of a particle, respectively, the commutator [x²,p²] is
question_gu: x અને p position અને momentum operatorsના x-components હોય તો [x²,p²] શું છે?
explanation_en: Using [x,p]=iℏ and [A,BC]=[A,B]C+B[A,C], [x²,p²]=[x²,p]p+p[x²,p]=2iℏ(xp+px). Thus D is correct.
explanation_gu: [x,p]=iℏ અને commutator identity વાપરીને [x²,p²]=2iℏ(xp+px) મળે છે. તેથી D સાચું છે.
tip_en: Use [x,p]=iℏ and expand the commutator systematically.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: If S1 and S2 are the spin operators of the two electrons of a helium atom, the value of ⟨S1·S2⟩ for the ground state is
question_gu: Helium atomના બે electrons માટે ground stateમાં ⟨S1·S2⟩નું મૂલ્ય શું છે?
explanation_en: The helium ground state has antiparallel electron spins forming a singlet with total spin S=0. Therefore S1·S2=1/2[S²−S1²−S2²]=−3ℏ²/4.
explanation_gu: Helium ground stateમાં બે electron singlet state બનાવે છે, એટલે S=0. તેથી S1·S2=−3ℏ²/4.
tip_en: For a two-electron singlet, ⟨S1·S2⟩=−3ℏ²/4.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The scattering of particles by a potential can be analyzed by Born approximation. The first Born approximation is valid for
question_gu: Potential દ્વારા particle scattering માટે first Born approximation કઈ સ્થિતિમાં valid છે?

options.A: Large incident energies and weak scattering potentials
options.B: Large incident energies and strong scattering potentials
options.C: Small incident energies and weak scattering potentials
options.D: Small incident energies and strong scattering potentials

explanation_en: The first Born approximation assumes that the scattering is weak, so the incident wave is only slightly perturbed. It is therefore applicable for high incident energy and/or weak scattering potential; among the choices, A is correct.
explanation_gu: First Born approximationમાં scattering weak હોવું જોઈએ જેથી incident wave બહુ બદલાય નહીં. આપેલા વિકલ્પોમાં high incident energy અને weak potential માટે A સાચું છે.
tip_en: Born approximation → weak scattering; high incident energy generally improves validity.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: For a system of N independent quantum harmonic oscillators, the canonical partition function is given by Z=exp(−Nβℏω/2)/[1−exp(−βℏω)]^N. The internal energy of the system will be
question_gu: N independent quantum harmonic oscillators માટે આપેલ canonical partition function પરથી internal energy શું છે?
explanation_en: Use U=−∂lnZ/∂β. Since lnZ=−Nβℏω/2−N ln(1−e^(−βℏω)), differentiation gives U=N[ℏω/2+ℏω/(e^(βℏω)−1)].
explanation_gu: U=−∂lnZ/∂β વાપરો. lnZ=−Nβℏω/2−N ln(1−e^(−βℏω))માંથી U=N[ℏω/2+ℏω/(e^(βℏω)−1)] મળે છે. તેથી A.
tip_en: Remember U=−∂lnZ/∂β for the canonical ensemble.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Consider a system with two energy levels E0=0 and E1=ε. The system is in contact with a heat reservoir at temperature T. With β=1/kT, the canonical partition function of the system will be
question_gu: બે energy levels E0=0 અને E1=ε ધરાવતા system માટે β=1/kT હોય તો canonical partition function શું છે?
explanation_en: The canonical partition function is Z=Σi exp(−βEi). For E0=0 and E1=ε, Z=1+exp(−βε).
explanation_gu: Canonical partition function Z=Σ exp(−βE). અહીં E0=0 અને E1=ε હોવાથી Z=1+e^(−βε).
tip_en: For discrete levels, sum e^(−βEi) over all allowed states.
tip_gu: Concept અને formula યાદ રાખો; examમાં units અને sign convention ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Identify the correct statement.
question_gu: સાચું statement ઓળખો.

options.A: The entropy of a system always increases when it undergoes an irreversible process
options.B: The entropy of a system always decreases when it undergoes an irreversible process
options.C: The second law of thermodynamics follows directly from the principle of the conservation of energy
options.D: The internal energy of an ideal gas does not depend on temperature

explanation_en: The GSET final key marks A. However, the wording is broader than the standard statement: for an irreversible process, the entropy of an isolated system (or the total entropy of system plus surroundings) increases, whereas the entropy of the system alone need not always increase. The official key is preserved and the item is flagged for review.
explanation_gu: GSET final key પ્રમાણે A છે. પરંતુ standard thermodynamicsમાં irreversible process માટે isolated system અથવા system+surroundingsની total entropy વધે છે; માત્ર systemની entropy હંમેશા વધે એવું જરૂરી નથી. તેથી official key A રાખીને review flag મૂક્યો છે.
review_note: Official final key A retained. Standard second-law wording normally refers to entropy increase of an isolated system/universe; system entropy alone can decrease.
tip_en: Distinguish entropy change of the system from entropy change of an isolated system/universe.
tip_gu: Systemની entropy અને isolated system/universeની entropy વચ્ચેનો તફાવત યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: If the number density of a free electron gas in three dimensions is increased eight times, its Fermi temperature will
question_gu: ત્રણ પરિમાણના free electron gasની number density આઠ ગણી વધારવામાં આવે તો તેનું Fermi temperature કેટલું થશે?
explanation_en: For a three-dimensional free electron gas, the Fermi energy and hence Fermi temperature scale as n^(2/3). If n becomes 8n, TF becomes 8^(2/3)TF=4TF.
explanation_gu: 3-D free electron gas માટે EF અને TF ∝ n^(2/3). તેથી n → 8n થાય તો TF → 8^(2/3)TF = 4TF.
tip_en: Remember TF ∝ n^(2/3) for a 3-D free electron gas.
tip_gu: 3-D free electron gas માટે TF ∝ n^(2/3) યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Helmholtz free energy (F) for a system of N independent harmonic oscillators in a canonical ensemble is given by F = N kT ln(ℏω/kT). What will be the entropy of the system?
question_gu: Canonical ensembleમાં N independent harmonic oscillators માટે Helmholtz free energy F = NkT ln(ℏω/kT) હોય તો systemની entropy કેટલી થશે?
explanation_en: Use S = −(∂F/∂T)V. Differentiating F=NkT ln(ℏω/kT) gives S=Nk[ln(kT/ℏω)+1]. Hence C.
explanation_gu: S = −(∂F/∂T)V વાપરો. F=NkT ln(ℏω/kT) ને T પ્રમાણે differentiate કરતાં S=Nk[ln(kT/ℏω)+1] મળે છે. તેથી C.
tip_en: For Helmholtz free energy, S = −∂F/∂T at constant volume.
tip_gu: Helmholtz free energy માટે S = −∂F/∂T (V constant) યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Consider a system of N atoms of an ideal gas of type A at temperature T and volume V. It is kept in diffusive contact with another system of N atoms of another ideal gas type B at the same temperature T and volume V. Once the combined system reaches equilibrium, which statement is correct?
question_gu: N atomsના ideal gas A ને T અને V પર રાખવામાં આવે છે અને સમાન T,V પર N atomsના અલગ ideal gas B સાથે diffusive contactમાં મૂકવામાં આવે છે. Equilibrium પછી કયું statement સાચું છે?

options.A: The total entropy of the final system is the same as the sum of the entropies of the individual systems
options.B: The entropy of mixing is 2Nk_B ln 2
options.C: The entropy of the final system is less than that of the sum of the entropies of the two gases
options.D: The entropy of the mixing is non zero when the atoms A and B are of the same type

explanation_en: For two equal amounts of distinguishable ideal gases, the entropy of mixing is ΔS_mix = N_A k_B ln 2 + N_B k_B ln 2 = 2Nk_B ln2. Therefore B is correct.
explanation_gu: બે સમાન માત્રાના distinguishable ideal gases માટે ΔS_mix = Nk_B ln2 + Nk_B ln2 = 2Nk_B ln2. તેથી B સાચું છે.
tip_en: For equal amounts of two distinguishable ideal gases, ΔS_mix = 2Nk_B ln2.
tip_gu: બે equal distinguishable gases માટે mixing entropy 2Nk_B ln2 થાય છે.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In a thermodynamic system in equilibrium, each molecule can exist in three possible states with the probabilities 1/2, 1/3 and 1/6, respectively. The entropy per molecule is
question_gu: Equilibriumમાં દરેક molecule ત્રણ possible statesમાં અનુક્રમે 1/2, 1/3 અને 1/6 probability સાથે રહી શકે છે. Per molecule entropy કેટલી છે?
explanation_en: Use S = −k_B Σ p_i ln p_i. Substituting 1/2, 1/3 and 1/6 gives S = k_B[(2/3)ln2 + (1/2)ln3], which is option A.
explanation_gu: Gibbs entropy S = −k_B Σp_i ln p_i. 1/2, 1/3 અને 1/6 મૂકી simplify કરતાં S = k_B[(2/3)ln2 + (1/2)ln3] મળે છે, એટલે A.
tip_en: For probabilities p_i, use S = −k_B Σ p_i ln p_i.
tip_gu: Probability-based entropy માટે S = −k_B Σp_i ln p_i વાપરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Which of the following does NOT pertain to digital systems?
question_gu: નીચેનામાંથી કયું digital systems સાથે સંબંધિત નથી?
explanation_en: Binary numbers, finite-difference methods and digital modulation are associated with digital/electronic systems. Second-order differential equations are a continuous mathematical model rather than a characteristic digital-system element. Hence D.
explanation_gu: Binary numbers, finite-difference methods અને digital modulation digital systems સાથે સંબંધિત છે. Second-order differential equations continuous mathematical model છે. તેથી D.
tip_en: Digital electronics માટે discrete/binary concepts યાદ રાખો.

question_en: Find out the differential input voltage (V_id) in the negative feedback amplifier shown. Given A_v = −500, β = −0.1 and V_s = 0.1 V.
question_gu: આપેલા negative-feedback amplifier માટે differential input voltage V_id શોધો. A_v=−500, β=−0.1 અને V_s=0.1 V છે.
explanation_en: For the shown feedback loop, Vo=A_v Vid and Vid=Vs−βVo. Therefore Vid=Vs/(1−βA_v)=0.1/[1−(−0.1)(−500)]=0.1/51≈0.00196 V≈0.002 V. Thus C.

question_en: The network shown below is a
question_gu: આપેલ network કયા પ્રકારનું filter છે?

question_en: The missing counts in the binary irregular counter shown below are

question_en: Find out which of the following is more versatile.

question_en: A solar cell has an open circuit voltage (V_OC) of 0.6 V and short circuit current (I_SC) of 2.5 A and fill factor of 0.7. If the incident power of light on the solar cell is 20 W, its efficiency is
question_gu: Solar cell માટે V_OC=0.6 V, I_SC=2.5 A, fill factor=0.7 અને incident power=20 W હોય તો efficiency કેટલી?

question_en: A silicon photodiode has a responsivity of 0.67 A/W at 850 nm. If light of 850 nm is incident on the photodiode and the measured photocurrent is 0.0134 mA, the power of the incident light is
question_gu: 850 nm પર silicon photodiodeની responsivity 0.67 A/W છે અને measured photocurrent 0.0134 mA છે. Incident light power કેટલી?

question_en: The target of X-ray tube is subjected to excitation voltage V. The wavelength of the excited X-rays is proportional to
question_gu: X-ray tubeના target પર excitation voltage V લાગુ પડે છે. Excited X-raysની wavelength શેના proportional છે?

question_en: The wavelength of a photon corresponding to the transition from n=3 to n=2 in hydrogen atom is closest to
question_gu: Hydrogen atomમાં n=3 થી n=2 transition માટે photonની wavelength આશરે કેટલી છે?
explanation_en: Using the Rydberg formula, 1/λ=R(1/2²−1/3²)=5R/36. This gives λ≈656.3 nm, the H-alpha line.
explanation_gu: Rydberg formulaથી 1/λ=R(1/4−1/9)=5R/36. તેથી λ≈656.3 nm, H-alpha line.
tip_en: Balmer H-alpha: n=3→2 gives 656.3 nm.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: For a particle in a one-dimensional infinite potential well of width L, the energy of the nth state is proportional to
question_gu: Width Lની 1-D infinite potential wellમાં nth stateની energy શેના proportional છે?
explanation_en: For an infinite square well En=n²π²ℏ²/(2mL²), hence En∝n²/L².
explanation_gu: Infinite well માટે En=n²π²ℏ²/(2mL²), એટલે En∝n²/L².
tip_en: Infinite well energy scales as n² and 1/L².
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The degeneracy of the first excited level of a three-dimensional isotropic harmonic oscillator is
question_gu: 3-D isotropic harmonic oscillatorના first excited levelની degeneracy કેટલી છે?
explanation_en: For a 3-D isotropic oscillator, states with nx+ny+nz=N have degeneracy (N+1)(N+2)/2. For the first excited level N=1, g=3.
explanation_gu: 3-D isotropic oscillatorમાં nx+ny+nz=N માટે degeneracy (N+1)(N+2)/2 છે. N=1 માટે g=3.
tip_en: For N=1, the three states are (1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1).
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: For an electric dipole transition, which selection rule is allowed?
question_gu: Electric dipole transition માટે કયો selection rule allowed છે?
explanation_en: The electric-dipole selection rule for orbital angular momentum is Δl=±1. For magnetic quantum number, Δm=0,±1.
explanation_gu: Electric dipole માટે મુખ્ય orbital selection rule Δl=±1 છે; Δm=0,±1 હોઈ શકે.
tip_en: E1 transition: Δl=±1.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The Landé g-factor for an electron state with L=1, S=1/2 and J=3/2 is
question_gu: L=1, S=1/2 અને J=3/2 ધરાવતા electron state માટે Landé g-factor શું છે?
tip_en: Memorize the Landé g-factor formula.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In the normal Zeeman effect, the spectral line splits into
question_gu: Normal Zeeman effectમાં spectral line કેટલા componentsમાં split થાય છે?
explanation_en: The normal Zeeman effect produces three equally spaced components: π (Δm=0) and σ± (Δm=±1).
explanation_gu: Normal Zeeman effectમાં ત્રણ equally spaced components મળે છે: π અને σ±.
tip_en: Normal Zeeman triplet = 3 components.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The nuclear binding energy per nucleon is maximum approximately near
question_gu: Nuclear binding energy per nucleon આશરે કયા mass regionમાં maximum હોય છે?
explanation_en: The binding energy per nucleon reaches its maximum near the iron/nickel region (around A≈56), making these nuclei among the most tightly bound.
explanation_gu: Binding energy per nucleon iron/nickel regionમાં maximum હોય છે, આશરે A≈56.
tip_en: Maximum B.E./nucleon → Fe/Ni region.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: In the liquid drop model, the term that mainly reduces the binding energy of a nucleus with increasing proton number is
question_gu: Liquid drop modelમાં proton number વધતાં binding energy ઘટાડવામાં મુખ્ય કયો term જવાબદાર છે?
explanation_en: The Coulomb term represents electrostatic repulsion between protons and is negative in the binding-energy formula. Its magnitude grows approximately as Z²/A^(1/3).
explanation_gu: Coulomb term protons વચ્ચેના electrostatic repulsionને દર્શાવે છે અને binding energyમાં negative contribution આપે છે; તેનું magnitude લગભગ Z²/A^(1/3) પ્રમાણે વધે છે.
tip_en: More protons → stronger Coulomb repulsion.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: For an allowed beta-minus decay, the emitted particles are
question_gu: Allowed beta-minus decayમાં emitted particles કયા છે?
explanation_en: In β− decay, a neutron converts into a proton with emission of an electron and an electron antineutrino: n→p+e−+anti-νe.
explanation_gu: β− decayમાં neutron protonમાં રૂપાંતરિત થાય છે અને electron તથા electron antineutrino emit થાય છે: n→p+e−+anti-νe.
tip_en: β− = electron + antineutrino.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: The threshold energy for the reaction p + p → p + p + π0 in the laboratory frame is approximately
question_gu: Lab frameમાં p+p→p+p+π0 reaction માટે threshold energy આશરે કેટલી છે?
explanation_en: At threshold the final particles have no relative kinetic energy in the center-of-momentum frame. Using invariant s and the target proton initially at rest gives a projectile kinetic energy of about 279.7 MeV, so the closest option is 280 MeV.
explanation_gu: Threshold પર CM frameમાં final particlesની relative kinetic energy zero હોય છે. Invariant s વાપરતાં projectile kinetic energy લગભગ 279.7 MeV મળે છે, એટલે closest option 280 MeV.
tip_en: For fixed-target reactions, threshold energy is much larger than just the rest energy of the produced particle.
tip_gu: Concept અને units ખાસ ચેક કરો.
source: GSET official December 2024 Physical Sciences question paper and final answer key

question_en: Two circular discs D1 and D2 of same thickness and same mass have different densities, ρ1 and ρ2. If ρ1 > ρ2, they are rotated about an axis passing through centre and perpendicular to the discs.
question_gu: સમાન mass અને thicknessમાં higher density એટલે smaller volume અને radius. Disc માટે I=MR²/2 હોવાથી D1નું moment of inertia ઓછું.

options.A: They have same moment of inertia
options.B: Moment of inertia of D1 > Moment of inertia of D2
options.C: Moment of inertia of D1 < Moment of inertia of D2

explanation_en: Equal mass and thickness with higher density means smaller volume and hence smaller radius. Since I=MR²/2 for a disc, D1 has smaller moment of inertia.
explanation_gu: Higher density at fixed mass means smaller radius.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: In the theory of small oscillations, generally the dependency of potential energy on the displacement of a particle from equilibrium position is:
question_gu: Stable equilibrium પાસે linear term vanish થાય છે અને leading term quadratic હોય છે: V≈V0+½kx².
explanation_en: Near stable equilibrium, the first derivative of potential energy vanishes and the leading term is quadratic: V≈V0+(1/2)kx².
explanation_gu: Small oscillation → quadratic potential.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The unit of Hamiltonian is the unit of:
question_gu: Hamiltonian energyનું quantity છે. Optionsમાં torqueનું unit N·m છે, જે joule સાથે dimensionally equivalent છે.
explanation_en: The Hamiltonian has dimensions of energy. Among the listed choices, torque has the same SI dimensions N·m as joule.
explanation_gu: Hamiltonian has dimensions of energy.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A pendulum bob of mass m is held taut in a horizontal position and then released. What is the tension in the string when the bob reaches its lowest position?
question_gu: Bob L ઊંચાઈથી પડે છે તેથી v²=2gL. Lowest point પર T−mg=mv²/L=2mg, એટલે T=3mg.
explanation_en: The bob falls through height L, so v²=2gL. At the lowest point, T−mg=mv²/L=2mg, giving T=3mg.
explanation_gu: Released horizontal pendulum: bottom tension = 3mg.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Reduced mass of a two body system depends on:
question_gu: Reduced mass μ=m1m2/(m1+m2) છે અને R કે r પર depend કરતી નથી.

options.A: Position of the centre of mass R
options.D: Neither on R nor on r

explanation_en: The reduced mass is μ=m1m2/(m1+m2), depending only on the two masses, not on coordinates R or r.
explanation_gu: Reduced mass depends only on the two masses.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Electric field variation for a uniformly charged sphere of radius R with constant charge density ρ is:
question_gu: Constant charge density ρ ધરાવતા radius Rના uniformly charged sphere માટે electric field કેવી રીતે vary થાય છે?
explanation_en: Inside a uniformly charged sphere, Gauss law gives E(4πr²)=ρ(4πr³/3)/ε0, hence E=ρr/(3ε0), so E∝r.
explanation_gu: Uniform sphereની અંદર Gauss lawથી E=ρr/(3ε0), એટલે E∝r.
tip_en: Inside uniformly charged sphere: E∝r.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following is false?
question_gu: નીચેનામાંથી કયું statement false છે?

options.A: An electron moving from point A to B in a straight line at uniform speed radiates
options.B: Proton moving in linear accelerator radiates
options.C: Proton moving in a circular orbit at constant speed radiates
options.D: Electron while moving through a potential difference of 2500 volts in a straight line radiates

explanation_en: Uniform straight-line motion has zero acceleration, so it does not radiate classically. The official key marks A.
explanation_gu: Uniform straight-line motionમાં acceleration zero છે, તેથી classical radiation થતું નથી. Official key A છે.
tip_en: Radiation is associated with accelerated charge.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following equations relating to electric field E and magnetic field B rules out the possibility of an isolated magnetic monopole?
question_gu: Electric field E અને magnetic field B સંબંધિત કયું equation isolated magnetic monopoleની possibility rule out કરે છે?
explanation_en: Gauss law for magnetism is ∇·B=0, which states that magnetic field has no isolated source or sink in classical Maxwell theory.
explanation_gu: Magnetism માટે Gauss law ∇·B=0 છે, એટલે classical Maxwell theoryમાં isolated magnetic monopole નથી.
tip_en: No magnetic monopoles → ∇·B=0.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A battery of EMF ε and internal resistance r is connected to variable load resistance R. The maximum power delivered to load resistance R is obtained by varying R. The battery loses the energy at the rate of:
question_gu: EMF ε અને internal resistance r ધરાવતી battery variable load R સાથે જોડાય છે. R=r પર maximum power મળે છે. Battery energy કયા rateથી lose કરે છે?
explanation_en: At maximum power R=r, the current is I=ε/(2r). The internal loss is I²r=ε²/(4r). The official key is C, so the source item/key convention should be reviewed because the direct internal-loss calculation gives option A.
explanation_gu: Maximum power માટે R=r અને I=ε/(2r). Internal loss I²r=ε²/(4r) મળે છે. Official key C છે, એટલે source/key discrepancy માટે review જરૂરી છે.
tip_en: Maximum power theorem: R=r; then calculate current and internal loss.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: A charged capacitor C is connected in series with an inductor L. When the displacement current is zero, the energy of LC circuit is:
question_gu: Charged capacitor C ને inductor L સાથે seriesમાં જોડવામાં આવે છે. Displacement current zero હોય ત્યારે LC circuitની energy શું છે?

options.A: stored entirely in its electric field
options.B: distributed equally among its electric and magnetic fields
options.D: stored entirely in its magnetic field

explanation_en: When current is zero, magnetic energy (1/2)LI² is zero. Therefore the conserved total energy is entirely electric, (1/2)CV².
explanation_gu: Current zero હોય ત્યારે magnetic energy zero છે. તેથી total conserved energy સંપૂર્ણ electric fieldમાં stored છે.
tip_en: At I=0, magnetic energy is zero.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The uncertainty relation applies to:
question_gu: Uncertainty relation કયા variables માટે લાગુ પડે છે?

options.C: A pair of dynamical variables which do not commute
options.D: A pair of dynamical variables which commute

explanation_en: The generalized uncertainty relation is ΔAΔB≥(1/2)|⟨[A,B]⟩|. Non-commuting observables give a nonzero lower bound in general.
explanation_gu: Generalized uncertainty relation ΔAΔB≥½|⟨[A,B]⟩| છે. Non-commuting observables માટે nonzero lower bound મળે છે.
tip_en: Uncertainty is tied to non-commutation.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Zero point energy of a three-dimensional harmonic oscillator in quantum mechanics is:
question_gu: Quantum mechanicsમાં three-dimensional harmonic oscillatorની zero-point energy કેટલી?
explanation_en: For a 3-D isotropic harmonic oscillator, the ground-state energy is 3ℏω/2.
explanation_gu: 3-D isotropic oscillator માટે ground-state energy 3ℏω/2 છે.
review_note: The scanned option lettering/formula is visually ambiguous; official key is preserved.
tip_en: 3-D zero-point energy = 3ℏω/2.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The magnitude of orbital angular momentum with quantum number l is:
question_gu: Orbital angular momentum માટે quantum number l હોય તો magnitude શું છે?
explanation_en: Since L² has eigenvalue l(l+1)ℏ², the magnitude is √[l(l+1)]ℏ.
explanation_gu: L²નું eigenvalue l(l+1)ℏ² છે, તેથી |L|=√[l(l+1)]ℏ.
tip_en: L²=l(l+1)ℏ².
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The dimension of wave function ψ in three-dimensional space is:
question_gu: Three-dimensional spaceમાં wave function ψનું dimension શું છે?
explanation_en: Normalization ∫|ψ|²d³r=1 requires |ψ|² to have dimension L^−3, hence ψ has dimension L^−3/2.
explanation_gu: Normalization ∫|ψ|²d³r=1 હોવાથી ψનું dimension L^−3/2 થાય છે.
tip_en: In 3-D, ψ has dimension L^−3/2.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The degeneracy of a level with principal quantum number n in a Hydrogen atom is:
question_gu: Hydrogen atomમાં principal quantum number n ધરાવતા levelની degeneracy કેટલી?
explanation_en: Including electron spin, the nth hydrogen level has degeneracy 2n²; without spin it is n².
explanation_gu: Electron spin સહિત degeneracy 2n² છે; spin વગર n² છે.
tip_en: Hydrogen degeneracy = 2n² including spin.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Which of the following is not an example of second order phase transition?
question_gu: નીચેનામાંથી કયું second-order phase transitionનું example નથી?

options.D: Superconducting state to normal state transition at Tc

explanation_en: Melting of ice to water is a first-order phase transition, whereas the other listed examples are associated with continuous/second-order transitions in the standard treatment.
explanation_gu: Iceનું waterમાં melting first-order phase transition છે; બાકીના examples standard treatmentમાં continuous/second-order transitions સાથે જોડાય છે.
tip_en: Melting is first-order; superconducting transition is second-order.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: In a Brownian motion, if D is diffusivity of Brownian particles and τ is diffusion time, then the dimension of Dτ is:
question_gu: Brownian motionમાં D diffusivity અને τ diffusion time હોય તો Dτનું dimension શું છે?
explanation_en: Diffusivity has dimension L²/T. Multiplying by time gives L², so Dτ has dimension M⁰L²T⁰.
explanation_gu: Diffusivityનું dimension L²/T છે. τથી multiply કરતાં Dτનું dimension L² એટલે M⁰L²T⁰ થાય છે.
tip_en: Diffusion coefficient D → L²/T.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: Superfluidity is a phenomenon connected to:
question_gu: Superfluidity કયા phenomenon સાથે connected છે?
explanation_en: Superfluidity is closely associated with Bose-Einstein condensation and macroscopic quantum coherence in bosonic systems.
explanation_gu: Superfluidity Bose-Einstein condensation અને macroscopic quantum coherence સાથે closely associated છે.
tip_en: Superfluidity → Bose-Einstein condensation.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The partition function of a single gas molecule is Z0. The partition function of N non-interacting identical gas molecules is:
question_gu: એક gas moleculeનું partition function Z0 હોય તો N non-interacting identical gas moleculesનું partition function શું છે?
explanation_en: For N non-interacting identical classical particles, the canonical partition function is Z=Z0^N/N! due to indistinguishability.
explanation_gu: N non-interacting identical classical particles માટે Z=Z0^N/N! થાય છે, કારણ કે particles indistinguishable છે.
tip_en: Identical classical particles → divide by N!.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key

question_en: The ratio Cp/Cv for a diatomic molecular gas:
question_gu: Diatomic molecular gas માટે Cp/Cv ratio:

options.B: increases continuously with increase in temperature
options.C: changes in steps at particular values of temperature
options.D: decreases continuously with increase in temperature

explanation_en: As additional rotational and vibrational degrees of freedom become thermally active at characteristic temperature ranges, Cp/Cv changes in steps in the idealized model.
explanation_gu: Temperature વધતાં rotational/vibrational degrees of freedom active થતાં Cp/Cv characteristic temperature ranges પર step-like change કરે છે.
tip_en: Degrees of freedom activate at characteristic temperatures.
tip_gu: મુખ્ય concept/formula યાદ રાખો.
source: GSET official September 2016 Physical Sciences Paper-II and final/corrected answer key
